title: Fix Work Center field persistence when auto-save is disabled
summary: When auto-save is disabled, validating Subcontractor No. on the Work Center Card now saves pending changes before refreshing, preventing field values from being discarded.
key_points: Validation of Subcontractor No. now saves the record before refreshing the page
Pending changes like Unit Cost Calculation are preserved instead of being lost
Subcontractor pricing actions remain immediately enabled or disabled based on field state
Added UI regression tests covering field persistence and action state behavior
Low-risk change with no schema or API modifications
quote: Change the refresh to save the record before updating the page.
